result.markdown:
# Call setup failures and dropped sessions due to bad configuration push

- **Classification:** incident
- **Root cause:** bad_change at `S-SFX-009`
- **Confidence:** medium (Direct evidence from change logs matching the KPI onset timing, plus ruled-out maintenance and transport issues.)
- **Impact:** 2026-09-17 01:00 to not established or ongoing
- **Cause time:** 2026-09-17 01:13
- **Affected:** S-SFX-009, S-SFX-001, S-SFX-004

## Summary

Push of RAN parameter template RT-2.4 adjusting admission control and RRC timers directly caused the degradation in RRC success rate and drop rate.

Call setup failures and dropped sessions rose at sites S-SFX-009, S-SFX-001, and S-SFX-004 starting at 2026-09-17 01:00.

## Timeline

- 2026-09-17 01:00: Earliest KPI onset detected with rrc_success_pct below baseline at S-SFX-009. [T3, ALR-0026]
- 2026-09-17 01:13: RAN parameter template RT-2.4 configuration push completed on S-SFX-009, S-SFX-001, and S-SFX-004. [CHG-2026-0042, CHG-2026-0040, CHG-2026-0041, T12]
- 2026-09-17 01:46: Minor RRC_FAILURE_RATE_HIGH alarm raised on S-SFX-004. [ALM-000361]
- 2026-09-17 01:55: Minor RRC_FAILURE_RATE_HIGH alarm raised on S-SFX-001. [ALM-000362]

## Evidence

- Deviation observed in 9 of 9 series with earliest KPI onset at 2026-09-17 01:00 where S-SFX-009 rrc_success_pct fell below baseline. [T3]
- Configuration push of RAN parameter template RT-2.4 occurred on S-SFX-009, S-SFX-001, and S-SFX-004 at 2026-09-17 01:13. [CHG-2026-0042, CHG-2026-0040, CHG-2026-0041, T12]
- No maintenance window was scheduled on the affected nodes or their parents during the incident window. [T7]
- An ongoing alert ALR-0026 started at 2026-09-17 01:00 covering S-SFX-009, S-SFX-001, and S-SFX-004. [T1, ALR-0026]

## Hypotheses

1. **bad_change** at S-SFX-009: confirmed. Configuration push of RT-2.4 adjusted admission control and RRC timers right around the onset of failures. [CHG-2026-0042, RB-BAD-CHANGE#02]
2. **transport_degradation** at LNK-SFX-01-A: rejected. Prior link degradations cleared hours before the KPI drops and showed no correlation with the active RRC alarms. [ALM-000358, ALM-000359, ALM-000360]

## Ruled out

- ALM-000356: Temperature high warning cleared hours before the incident window and did not impact KPIs.
- ALM-000358: Minor link degraded alarm on LNK-SFX-01-A cleared at 22:25, well before the 01:00 KPI degradation.

## Recommended actions

- Roll back RAN parameter template RT-2.4 on S-SFX-009, S-SFX-001, and S-SFX-004.
- Monitor RRC success rate and drop rate KPIs following the rollback.
